title: Chapter 2903 - 159: Twenty
content:
Chapter 2903: Chapter 159: Twenty-Four Patterns (Part 3)

At the peak of twenty-three patterns, I suddenly encountered a major hurdle.

It seemed as if a "chasm" appeared between realms, and all the telekinesis consumed was poured into this "groove."

This was the bottleneck of Divine Sense.

Moreover, this was the greatest bottleneck of Divine Sense that Mo Hua encountered after entering the Golden Core.

Twenty-three patterns signify the Early Golden Core phase.

And crossing over to twenty-four patterns signifies the Middle Golden Core phase.

This is a bottleneck of the middle realm; breaking through requires filling this "groove" in the Sea of Consciousness, inevitably exhausting a great deal of effort and consuming an immense amount of telekinesis.

But Mo Hua was not flustered.

Because there’s plenty of telekinesis left from the Wujiu Great God.

Although this Wujiu Great God wasn’t very strong in combat, he was considered one of the "ancient" deities of the Great Wilderness, cultivated there for years, with a profoundly deep foundation of telekinesis.

Now all his divine way’s foundation has fallen into Mo Hua’s hands.

Mo Hua didn’t believe that after consuming such a deity, he couldn’t fill the gap in Divine Sense from twenty-three to twenty-four patterns...

Mo Hua continued to focus intensely, devouring relentlessly.

One wave of telekinesis after another was refined by him, swallowed into his belly, slowly refined within his body of Divine Thought, gradually assimilating and transforming to his divine way foundation, step by step enhancing his Divine Sense realm.

Wujiu’s telekinesis didn’t lose even a fraction.

Mo Hua’s Divine Sense, consequently, strengthened by a fraction.

Thus, Mo Hua kept eating, kept eating.

He didn’t know how long he had eaten or how much he had consumed.

Eventually, he got somewhat numb from eating, felt like he wanted to "vomit," yet Mo Hua didn’t give up, continuing the mechanical, force-feeding devouring...

The Heaven Yan Jue he cultivated, walking the path of Divine Sense Proving the Dao, his very existence being near deity, thus the "gap" between his Divine Sense realms was particularly daunting.

This was utterly beyond what ordinary people could comprehend in terms of Divine Sense volume.

Therefore, Mo Hua’s cultivation was overwhelmingly arduous, exceedingly long, exceedingly tormenting.

But even so, Mo Hua did not relinquish.

As long as there was a chance, he seized it.

As long as there was a slight opportunity to strengthen his Divine Sense, he wouldn’t miss it.

Luckily, this Wujiu Great God before him seemed to be the "gift" of Heavenly Dao rewarding diligence.

Finally, not knowing how much he had consumed or how long he had refined, Mo Hua, who had fallen into a "Taotie" state, mindlessly devouring, suddenly trembled intensely.

He could sense that some "bottleneck" seemed to have dissolved.

Under his relentless devouring and refining, the "chasm" had been filled.

Simultaneously, an extremely powerful sensation swept through his entire body.

He vaguely felt as if his Divine Thought had crossed a certain threshold, becoming stronger than before.

Moreover, not just on the "quantity" level.

Because this was a middle realm breakthrough, Mo Hua felt his Divine Sense underwent a deeper "qualitative change."

The muscles and bones of the telekinesis body were further fortified, becoming more condensed, more solid. The power of every punch and kick was stronger than before.

The foundation of the entire divine way realm also became more stable than before.

Now, going to fight the Wujiu Great God would be extremely easy for him.

Even because his Divine Sense was stronger, the oppressive weight brought by the fateful evilness within his Life Chart seemed to lighten...

"Twenty-four patterns!!"

"My Divine Thought has finally reached... twenty-four patterns..."

Mo Hua was stunned for a long while, and then an indescribable excitement surged from his heart, filling his chest, spreading throughout his body.

Twenty-four patterns were the most crucial milestone in his cultivation thus far.

Upon reaching twenty-four patterns, he could truly begin learning the Second Grade’s personal Ultimate Formation, Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation.

And once the personal Ultimate Formation is refined, it will pave the foundation for the next stage.

"I can finally..."

Mo Hua took a deep breath, suppressing his excitement, "Advance to the Golden Core..."
